key_insight: CURE is a lightweight multimodal fusion framework that sequentially combines heterogeneous medical data with hybrid geometry-aware attention to improve accuracy and efficiency.
clinical_relevance: It could help healthcare AI systems make more reliable predictions by better integrating imaging, clinical, and omics data without heavy compute demands.
method: Uses cascaded HyFuse layers to add modalities one by one for scalable fusion.
Combines residual convolution with hybrid-space attention to capture multi-scale and cross-modal structure.
Adds late-fusion and shared-information refinement to produce robust, order-invariant representations.
evidence_signal: Evaluated across 16 public datasets, CURE improved performance by up to 3.97% while reducing computational cost by up to 87.8%.
watch_item: The framework’s real-world value will depend on how well it transfers across institutions, modality combinations, and data quality differences not fully reflected in benchmark datasets.
paper_title: Advancing Multimodal Fusion on Heterogeneous Medical Data with Hybrid Geometry Attention
